## About This Loan

**OPEN DENTAL SOFTWARE, INC.** received a PPP loan of **$2,337,300** approved on Apr 6, 2020. The loan was originated by **Willamette Valley Bank**.

OPEN DENTAL SOFTWARE, INC. is a corporation located in [SALEM](https://ppprecipients.com/state/or/salem), [Oregon](https://ppprecipients.com/state/or). At the time of the application, the business was described as "existing or more than 2 years old".

The business operates in the [Computer Systems Design and Related Services](https://ppprecipients.com/industry/5415) industry (NAICS 541511), part of the **Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services** sector of the economy. The applicant reported 285 jobs as retained through this loan.

The SBA forgave $2,364,323.03 of this loan — 101.2% of the total approved amount, with forgiveness recorded on Jun 11, 2021. This means the borrower was not required to repay this portion, having satisfied the PPP's eligibility criteria for forgiveness, including maintaining payroll levels and using the funds for qualified expenses.

According to the SBA's records, the proceeds of this loan were allocated as follows: $1,752,975 to payroll, $584,325 to utilities. The payroll component represents 75.0% of disclosed proceeds, consistent with the program's requirement that at least 60% of loan funds be used for payroll costs to qualify for full forgiveness.

This loan is one of millions approved nationwide during the COVID-19 pandemic. To explore other recipients in Oregon, visit the [Oregon page](https://ppprecipients.com/state/or). To compare this loan with others in the same industry, see the [Computer Systems Design and Related Services industry page](https://ppprecipients.com/industry/5415).
